svg.aria-label: ArcMD: swiping from a pink Personal space to an orange Reading space and back; each space has its own colors, files and open page

g.text: Writing can be simple. Open a page and note what you're thinking.
Let the words slowly find their own shape.
Good tools keep you on the content. Use clear words and a little room.
No need to finish now — get it down first.
Finish the last chapter of a book
Gather the ideas scattered across notes
Half an hour of quiet writing
Break a big thing into steps, and the beginning shows itself.
How one idea leads to another
Books that changed how I see things, one page each.
A novel about trees, and the slow, quiet attention
Read slowly. Keep one line you want to remember.
“The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago.”
